what.en: The street address of the food facility the plans are for itself, with suite or unit. Not a mailing, head-office or overseas address, and not a P.O. box. Business name/DBA first, then the address.
what.zh: 填写图纸所对应的食品设施本身的街道地址（含门牌号/单元号）。不能填写邮寄地址、总部地址、海外地址或邮政信箱。先填商号/DBA，再填地址。

ifNone.en: This line names the US location being permitted, so there is no substitute: secure the lease or site first, then file with that address.
ifNone.zh: 此栏填写的是申请许可的美国经营地点本身，没有替代方案：请先签订租约或确定场地，再用该地址申请。

confirmations.quote: Contact your local planning/building department for permission to construct a restaurant at your chosen location
Los Angeles County Environmental Health does not provide services in the cities of Long Beach
Every person proposing to construct, remodel or change the Public Health License or Permit classification of any business

what.en: The address of the business owner or corporation. The sources do not say whether an address outside the US is accepted.
what.zh: 企业业主或公司的地址。现有官方资料未说明是否接受美国境外地址。

ifNone.en: Use a US address where mail is reliably picked up (the store once leased, or a US office or agent). Placetta asks the agency before using an address abroad.
ifNone.zh: 请使用能可靠收件的美国地址（租下门店后的门店地址，或美国办公室、代理人地址）。如需使用境外地址，Placetta 会先向该机构确认。

confirmations.quote: BUSINESS OWNER BUSINESS OWNER/CORPORATION NAME: PHONE #: ADDRESS: EMAIL:

notes: LA County pages opened on admin.publichealth.lacounty.gov (see lac-health-permit). Owner address is unconfirmed: only the form shows it.
